name: Zofia Nowak
bio:
Zofia's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly, through a local engineering club in her small Polish town. What started as a hobby quickly transformed into a passion, fueled by a natural aptitude for precision and problem-solving. She excelled in fabricating intricate components, earning the attention of a junior karting team, where she honed her skills for several years before joining Birel ART Factory.

As a fabricator, Zofia is meticulous and unwavering in her pursuit of perfection. She believes that even the smallest imperfection can compromise performance on the track, and she instills this philosophy in her team. Her innovative approach to fabrication, often incorporating unconventional techniques, has resulted in significant performance gains. Zofia's ability to translate complex engineering concepts into tangible, race-winning parts is what sets her apart.

physical.hairStyle: shoulder-length, often pulled back into a practical braid
physical.description: Zofia is of average height with a determined expression and strong hands.

quirks: Always carries a small, worn notebook filled with fabrication ideas.
Insists on polishing every weld, regardless of its visibility.
Can often be found sketching new component designs on workshop napkins during lunch.
